card.name: Inside brand and drug names
card.fires_on: Middle pieces of rare brand or generic drug names split into several parts, such as TECENTRIQ, NULOJIX, VALCYTE, raxibacumab and cidofovir. It fires on the piece before the name finishes.

modes.label: Brand names in capitals
modes.description: Middle piece of an uppercase brand name partway through spelling.
modes.example: Verify pregnancy status of females of reproductive potential prior to initiating TECENT<<RI>>Q HYBREZA.

modes.label: Generic drug names
modes.description: Middle piece of a lowercase generic name, often after a dose or in a heading.
modes.example: Each single-use vial allows delivery of 34 mL raxibac<<um>>ab.

card.writes: Little clear output effect; it mildly favors table-like separators and braces, suggesting the name's continuation is handled elsewhere.
card.plain: It lights up in the middle of an unusual drug name, before the name is finished.
